triggers.deuz_budget_totals_insert:
CREATE TRIGGER deuz_budget_totals_insert AFTER INSERT ON deuz_budget_counters BEGIN
      INSERT INTO deuz_budget_totals(key, tokens, usd) VALUES (NEW.key, NEW.tokens, NEW.usd)
      ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET tokens = tokens + excluded.tokens, usd = usd + excluded.usd;
    END
triggers.deuz_budget_totals_update:
CREATE TRIGGER deuz_budget_totals_update AFTER UPDATE ON deuz_budget_counters BEGIN
      UPDATE deuz_budget_totals SET tokens = tokens + NEW.tokens - OLD.tokens,
        usd = usd + NEW.usd - OLD.usd WHERE key = NEW.key;
    END
triggers.deuz_budget_totals_delete:
CREATE TRIGGER deuz_budget_totals_delete AFTER DELETE ON deuz_budget_counters BEGIN
      UPDATE deuz_budget_totals SET tokens = tokens - OLD.tokens, usd = usd - OLD.usd
        WHERE key = OLD.key;
    END

sql: CREATE TABLE deuz_budget_schema (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1), version INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE deuz_budget_scopes (
            key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, window_ms INTEGER, buckets INTEGER NOT NULL, bucket_ms INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE deuz_budget_counters (
            key TEXT NOT NULL, bucket INTEGER NOT NULL, model_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, usd REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(key, bucket, model_id))

CREATE TABLE deuz_budget_requests (
            request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, model_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, usd REAL NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, charges TEXT NOT NULL,
            actual_tokens INTEGER, actual_usd REAL, outcome TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX deuz_budget_requests_state ON deuz_budget_requests(state, created_at)
CREATE TABLE deuz_budget_totals (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, usd REAL NOT NULL)

CREATE TRIGGER deuz_budget_totals_insert AFTER INSERT ON deuz_budget_counters BEGIN
      INSERT INTO deuz_budget_totals(key, tokens, usd) VALUES (NEW.key, NEW.tokens, NEW.usd)
      ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET tokens = tokens + excluded.tokens, usd = usd + excluded.usd;
    END

CREATE TRIGGER deuz_budget_totals_update AFTER UPDATE ON deuz_budget_counters BEGIN
      UPDATE deuz_budget_totals SET tokens = tokens + NEW.tokens - OLD.tokens,
        usd = usd + NEW.usd - OLD.usd WHERE key = NEW.key;
    END

CREATE TRIGGER deuz_budget_totals_delete AFTER DELETE ON deuz_budget_counters BEGIN
      UPDATE deuz_budget_totals SET tokens = tokens - OLD.tokens, usd = usd - OLD.usd
        WHERE key = OLD.key;
    END
CREATE TABLE deuz_evolve_schema (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1), version INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE deuz_evolve_runs (
              scope TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
              status TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL,
              PRIMARY KEY(scope, run_id))

CREATE TABLE deuz_evolve_candidates (
              scope TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
              generation INTEGER NOT NULL, island INTEGER NOT NULL, slot INTEGER NOT NULL,
              payload TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(scope, run_id, candidate_id))

CREATE INDEX deuz_evolve_candidates_order
              ON deuz_evolve_candidates(scope, run_id, generation, island, slot)
CREATE TABLE deuz_ops_schema (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1), version INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE deuz_leases (
              key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL, token INTEGER NOT NULL,
              expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, signals TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE deuz_agent_runs (
              run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, scope TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
              payload TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE deuz_claims (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, claimed_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX deuz_claims_claimed_at ON deuz_claims(claimed_at)
CREATE INDEX deuz_agent_runs_updated_at ON deuz_agent_runs(updated_at)

CREATE TABLE deuz_memory (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  text TEXT NOT NULL,
  hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  user_id TEXT,
  agent_id TEXT,
  run_id TEXT,
  actor_id TEXT,
  chat_id TEXT,
  importance REAL,
  metadata TEXT,
  embedding BLOB,
  embedding_model_id TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_accessed_at INTEGER,
  expires_at INTEGER,
  valid_at INTEGER,
  invalid_at INTEGER
)
CREATE INDEX deuz_memory_scope_idx ON deuz_memory (user_id, agent_id, chat_id)
CREATE INDEX deuz_memory_hash_idx ON deuz_memory (hash)

CREATE INDEX deuz_memory_expiry_idx ON deuz_memory (expires_at)
  WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE deuz_chats (
  chat_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT,
  agent_id TEXT,
  run_id TEXT,
  actor_id TEXT,
  scope_chat_id TEXT,
  parent_id TEXT,
  record TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX deuz_chats_scope_idx ON deuz_chats (user_id, agent_id, scope_chat_id)

CREATE TABLE deuz_sessions (
  run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  status TEXT NOT NULL,
  step_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
  checkpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE deuz_runs (
  run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  status TEXT NOT NULL,
  record TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX deuz_runs_status_idx ON deuz_runs (status)

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE deuz_memory_fts
  USING fts5(text, content='deuz_memory', content_rowid='rowid')
CREATE TABLE deuz_swarm_schema (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1), version INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE deuz_swarm_runs (
            scope TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL,
            status TEXT, updated_at INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(scope, run_id))

CREATE TABLE deuz_swarm_tasks (
            scope TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
            payload TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(scope, run_id, task_id))

CREATE TABLE deuz_swarm_events (
            scope TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(scope, run_id, sequence))

CREATE TABLE deuz_swarm_channels (
    scope TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, channel TEXT NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
    entry_id TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(scope, run_id, channel, sequence), UNIQUE(scope, run_id, entry_id))
CREATE INDEX deuz_swarm_runs_status ON deuz_swarm_runs(scope, status, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX deuz_swarm_runs_settled ON deuz_swarm_runs(status, updated_at)
